title: A game master's announcement and kick reach a wizard standing in the Commons
notes: The entry of enter-the-commons.json, then two game server console commands a game master has.
'server announce' sends MSG_SERVERMESSAGE to every wizard in the world, and the client shows the text
and logs it as a server message. 'kick' sends MSG_FORCE_DISCONNECT with Type the string hash of CSR,
52803, the one reason the client answers with its game master disconnect, and closes the connection,
so the client shows that dialog rather than a lost connection.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added

steps.name: the client brings its renderer up
the login window is on the screen
log in
the server decodes the authentication message field by field
steps.pattern: sent MSG_USER_AUTHEN_V3: version (W\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+), revision \S+, data revision \S+, locale \S+, machine [0-9A-F]+,

steps.name: the server accepts the password
the client is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the server lists the wizard the run made
the character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen
the wizard on the character selection screen
press play

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server spends the key
the game server sends the wizard its object
steps.pattern: put wizard \d+ in (\S+) instance \d+ at .* and sent its \d+-byte object

steps.name: the client loading the zone
the client loads the zone and the wizard stands in it
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard \d+ stands in the world

steps.name: the game server says what MSG_LOGINCOMPLETE carried
steps.pattern: sent MSG_LOGINCOMPLETE: zone (\S+), id \d+, dynamic zone \d+ in process \d+, server time \d+, realm .+, permissions 0x[0-9a-f]+, CSR \d, test server \d, critical objects none

steps.name: the wizard standing in the Commons
a game master announces to everyone in the world
steps.command: server announce Welcome to the Commons, {user}!
steps.pattern: Shown to 1 wizard\(s\) in the world

steps.name: the client takes the server message
the announcement on the client's screen
a game master kicks the wizard by its character id
the game server gives the client the reason a game master's kick has
steps.pattern: Kicking session \d+ from \S+ with disconnect type (\d+)

steps.name: the client takes the disconnect
the client's disconnect dialog
